title: Busy bees
text:
Bees are small insects. They have six legs and four wings. Most bees are yellow and black.

Bees live together in a home called a hive. Many hundreds of bees can live in one hive.

Bees visit flowers. They drink a sweet juice from each flower. This juice is called nectar.

Bees take the nectar back to the hive. There they turn it into honey. Honey is sweet and sticky. We can eat it on bread.

A bee can sting if it is scared. So we should stay still and calm when a bee is near.

Bees are very helpful. When they visit flowers, they help plants to make seeds and fruit.
